protocol.name: Drift Perpetuals Exchange
protocol.note: C27 build (2026-08-09) from the official deployed-program IDL (scripts/drift_idl.json, committed for reproducibility). All 249 discriminators are DERIVED as sha256("global:"+snake_case_name)[0..8] (the IDLs carry no byte arrays) and VERIFIED LIVE by on-chain census (scripts/census_drift_kamino.py, base58-correct decode): placePerpOrder=45a15dca787e4cb9, cancelOrdersByIds=861390a55ef0d25e, placeOrders=3c3f327b0cc53cbe all matched the derived value with zero unmatched — the convention is proven on the deployed binary. PDA seeds are grounded ONLY where the deployed program's account struct seed-constrains the derivation (C26: a wrong seed spec would flag legitimate txs): Drift initialize_user user=[user,authority,sub_account_id], initialize_user_stats user_stats=[user_stats,authority], deposit/withdraw/transfer_deposit spot_market_vault=[spot_market_vault,market_index], withdraw drift_signer=[drift_signer]; Kamino lending_market_authority=[lma,market] (every ix carrying it), init_reserve vaults=[reserve_liq_supply|fee_receiver|reserve_coll_mint|reserve_coll_supply, reserve] (ONLY init_reserve — runtime ixs constrain vaults by address-from-state, not PDA), init_user_metadata user_metadata=[user_meta,owner], init_obligation obligation=[tag,id,owner,market,seed1,seed2].
